scenes.title: Destroyer Passage
scenes.tip: Establish the hull against the planet at wide zoom. Hold Solo through the breakdown and release on the downbeat to bring back the sun.

variants.title: Orbital passage → Stern approach
variants.caption: Watch Opposite move from Orbital passage to Stern approach. Strip 8’s bottom knob brings in the science view. Return it to zero for the natural materials. Fader 3 controls the strength of the musical response. Solo holds totality. Release to uncover the sun in half a second as the ship keeps moving.
variants.source: Edition V seven-bank Syphon tour · shader shared with Edition VI · silent

variants.title: Bathyal Engine
variants.caption: Follow the warm signal inside the mantle past a fixed seabed vent. Give the outer fin a quiet phrase before the next accent. On Destroyer Passage turn strip 1’s bottom knob past 70%. At 96% Bathyal Engine fills the frame. Hold the mantle in a quiet passage, then let the gills answer the next accent. Return below 70% for the ship.
variants.source: Edition V seven-bank Syphon tour · shader shared with Edition VI · silent

variants.title: Totality and release
variants.caption: Hold SOLO through totality and release it as the star emerges behind the hull.
variants.source: Edition V eclipse performance · current shared optical shader · silent

scenes.title: Echo Sounding

Fader 3 controls the strength of the musical response. Hold Solo to load the bass input and release it to accent kick. MaterialDepth sets the strength. Release the button before changing the route.

controls.title: Choose scene
controls.description: Select one of the four scenes in the current bank. The bottom, one-third, two-thirds and top positions land on scenes 1–4.
context: Use with Auto Director below halfway. A move during a crossfade takes effect after the current fade finishes.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Auto Director
controls.description: Turn past halfway to let musical phrases choose the scene. A drop calls scene 3. A build or break can call scene 2 or 4 at a bar boundary.
context: It stays within the selected bank and holds its choice through silence. Turn down to return control to the Chapter fader.
Filmed in Trench Run.
This lesson sends a test drop cue into the phrase detector’s output.

controls.title: Scene fade time
controls.description: Set the time for a change of scene or bank, from 0.12 to 2.12 seconds.
context: Change Chapter or bank to see the fade. Opposite has its own smoothing.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Structure and studies
controls.description: Change the scene’s construction and how far a build, drop or break pushes its Shape.
context: In Night Orchard, 58–92% brings in Drosera, Relief or Fold on face A, or Aurelia on Release face B. In Destroyer Passage, 70–96% brings in Bathyal Engine. StudyFader and EncounterFader can take over those mixes.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Opposite face
controls.description: Move from the first face of a scene to its opposing image. Pause midway to play the transition.
context: Each of the 24 space and cinema scenes can have its own fader. A scene fader set to −1 follows this strip. Bathyal Engine, Night Orchard and Lantern Run follow the strip directly.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Shape
controls.description: Reshape the main form. In Lantern Fair this changes the wheel radius. In Cutting Room it changes the light on the record.
context: The shape sent to the scene can also shift with a build, drop or break, according to React and Structure.
Filmed in Porcelain Storm.

controls.title: Detail
controls.description: Change the scene’s fine detail. In Lantern Run, raising it adds small airborne sprites.
context: The artwork determines which details change. Zoom still controls camera framing.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Motion swing
controls.description: Vary travel speed within each beat. Raise it for a stronger surge and ease.
context: In free-running mode the kick drives the surge. The Motion Speed fader sets the underlying speed.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Audio response
controls.description: Scale the six musical signals sent to the artwork and the phrase contribution to Shape.
context: At zero, automatic travel and manual gestures still work. The audio analyser, tempo detection and Auto Director operate independently.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Bass response
controls.description: Scale the mix of bass and sub-bass sent to the selected scene.
context: React and a live low-frequency signal are required. This sets visual response after audio analysis.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Kick response
controls.description: Scale the kick attack and the supporting pulse from a confident beat lock.
context: Look for the stem bending in Disco Jungle or the floor fixtures catching the kick in Lantern Run. React controls the overall response.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Snare response
controls.description: Scale the midrange onset that the artwork receives as a snare accent.
context: Requires React and a transient in the track. In Lantern Run, look at the airborne sprites.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Motion speed
controls.description: Set how quickly the scene travels. At the bottom the travel clock stops. The upper half gives progressively more speed.
context: Half, Normal and Double Rate multiply this speed. Beat Sync sets the clock source. Tap Tempo sets the beat interval.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Hi-hat response
controls.description: Scale the visual response to short high-frequency attacks and sustained high-frequency energy.
context: React sets the overall strength. Look for small paper, leaf or foil movements in the Lantern Run scenes.
Filmed in Release.

controls.title: Musical energy response
controls.description: Scale the broader musical energy envelope sent to the artwork.
context: Use sustained and quieter passages to hear the difference in the source. The resulting motion or light depends on the scene.
Filmed in Asteroid Foundry.

controls.title: Stereo width response
controls.description: Scale how much measured left–right difference in the music reaches the artwork.
context: Try a stereo passage with React up. In Lantern Run it affects the width of the local light pool. Zoom controls the camera.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: Camera zoom
controls.description: Pull down to see more of the world. Push up to bring the subject closer.
context: The camera is applied inside the scene. Centre X and Y frame the subject within that view.
Filmed in Dune Freight.

controls.title: Camera centre X
controls.description: Pan the framing horizontally. Halfway centres the view.
context: Available in Lantern Run as well as the cinema and space scenes.
Filmed in Dune Freight.

controls.title: Camera centre Y
controls.description: Pan the framing vertically. Halfway centres the view.
context: Useful for following a foreground subject as you move Zoom.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Camera roll
controls.description: Roll the camera around its viewing axis. Halfway gives a level horizon.
context: Lantern Run keeps its pixel-art horizon level and uses Zoom, Centre X and Centre Y for framing.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Colour zone mix
controls.description: Fade a separately coloured area onto the picture. Pull fully down to use the three knobs on this strip for optics.
context: On the factory mapping, below 1.5% the knobs set Focus Plane, Aperture and Laser Level. Raising Zone Mix keeps the last lens settings.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Zone position / focus
controls.description: With the zone open, move its centre along the selected angle. With the fader fully down, rack focus from the background toward the foreground.
context: The focus shift is visible in the depth-rendered Outer Rim scenes with Aperture open.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Zone width / aperture
controls.description: With the zone open, change its width or radius. With the fader fully down, open the lens aperture for stronger defocus.
context: Outer Rim has depth-aware focus. Other non-pixel scenes have a subtler edge-softening response to Aperture.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Zone angle / laser level
controls.description: With the zone open, turn the colour band or its centre’s travel axis. With the fader fully down, set the scene’s laser level.
context: Destroyer Passage, Echo Sounding and Dune Freight use Laser Level. Centre a circular zone to see why its angle has little effect there.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Colour saturation
controls.description: Move from grayscale at the bottom through the original colour at halfway to stronger colour at the top.
context: Grades the whole program after the zone tint.
Filmed in Ring Shepherd.

controls.title: Body hue
controls.description: Rotate the main palette. In Lantern Run this changes the sky and scenery.
context: The artwork assigns the main and accent colours separately. At zero the authored hue is preserved.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Accent hue
controls.description: Rotate the accent palette. In Lantern Run this changes the colour of the flame.
context: Use Body Hue for the surrounding scenery. Which highlights receive the accent depends on the artwork.
Filmed in Magnetar.

controls.title: Zone hue
controls.description: Choose the colour printed inside the selected zone. Bright highlights keep some of their original luminance.
context: Raise Zone Mix and Saturation to make the selected colour visible.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Output contrast
controls.description: Reduce or increase contrast around the stage’s dark midtones. Halfway preserves the authored contrast.
context: Grades the whole program, including Lantern Run.
Filmed in Briar Causeway.

controls.title: Zone edge softness
controls.description: Feather the border between the zone tint and the surrounding image.
context: Raise Zone Mix and choose a contrasting Zone Hue to see the edge.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Zone shape
controls.description: Morph the zone from a band to a round spot.
context: Zone Width sets its size. Zone Position and Angle place it in the picture.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Archive / science view / ink lift
controls.description: In the five space banks, mix the scene with its credited archive shader. In Outer Rim, bring up the subject’s science view. In Night Orchard, lift the dark ink.
context: Lantern Run uses the separate SpaceInkLift Global for its black level. On the factory mapping ArchiveMix follows this knob.
Filmed in Cloud City.

controls.title: Master light
controls.description: Fade the final picture to black or return it to full output.
context: Covers all banks. The clocks, router and sound analysis keep running during a blackout.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Blast / courier jump
controls.description: Send a short refraction wave across the stage. In Lantern Run, launch the courier on the button press.
context: A jump lasts 0.70 seconds and can launch again after landing. Quantize and Roll apply to the stage hit. The courier takes off immediately, even with Quantize on.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Shards
controls.description: Break the image into briefly displaced facets.
context: The full Lantern Run picture bypasses this stage effect to keep the pixel grid intact.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Echo
controls.description: Layer successively enlarged copies of the picture for a short visual echo.
context: The full Lantern Run picture bypasses this stage effect to keep the pixel grid intact.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Iris
controls.description: Close and reopen the stage’s six-blade aperture as a timed hit.
context: The full Lantern Run picture bypasses this stage effect to keep the pixel grid intact.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Orbit
controls.description: Twist the image around its centre, then let it unwind.
context: The full Lantern Run picture bypasses this stage effect to keep the pixel grid intact.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Flare
controls.description: Sweep a bright slit across the scene and boost the beam in laser-equipped scenes.
context: The full Lantern Run picture bypasses this stage effect to keep the pixel grid intact.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Supernova / lantern burst
controls.description: Play a sequence of Blast, Shards, Flare and Echo. In Lantern Run, light the courier’s lantern instead.
context: The sequence lasts 2½ beats. With Quantize on, the burst waits for the beat.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Clear effects
controls.description: Clear the active hit envelopes, pending quantized hits and the current roll.
context: If Roll is held, release it to arm the next roll. A courier already in the air completes the jump.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Half speed
controls.description: Latch travel to half the current fader speed.
context: Tempo, effect durations and the spacing of roll repeats still use the instrument beat.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Normal speed
controls.description: Return travel to the speed set by the Motion Speed fader.
context: This restores the multiplier to 1×. Beat Sync and the instrument tempo keep their current settings.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.
Measured travel multiplier moved from 0.5× to 1×.

controls.title: Double speed
controls.description: Latch travel to twice the current fader speed.
context: Use for a faster passage at the same musical tempo. A stopped travel fader stays stopped.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.
Measured travel multiplier moved from 1× to 2×.

controls.title: Beat sync / free travel
controls.description: Toggle travel between musical beats and elapsed seconds. The show starts in beat-sync mode.
context: The instrument beat continues in either mode for roll, hit timing and quantization.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Quantize hits
controls.description: Toggle whether stage hits start immediately or wait for the next instrument beat.
context: The show starts with immediate hits. The Lantern Run jump always responds to the button edge.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Roll last hit
controls.description: Hold to repeat the last selected effect every half beat. Release to end the roll.
context: Blast is the initial voice. In Lantern Run a rolled Supernova can repeat the lantern burst. Repeated stage hits do not launch jumps.
Filmed in Peak.

controls.title: Tap tempo
controls.description: Tap twice, 0.28–1 second apart, to set the instrument beat. Further taps update it and align the beat to your press.
context: Tap tempo takes priority for eight seconds. A confident audio lock can then take over. The music playback speed stays unchanged.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.
Measured tempo moved from 120 to 195 BPM.

controls.title: Hold travel
controls.description: Hold to stop the travel clock. Release to continue from the held position.
context: Also holds the courier in midair and pauses the Disco Jungle stem spring. Audio accents, beat timing and scene fades can continue.
Filmed in Lantern Fair.

controls.title: Bank Left
controls.description: Step one bank backward on each press. Keep the same scene position within the new bank.
context: The eight banks wrap around. From Outer Rim, one press left reaches Lantern Run. Fade Time sets the transition.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: Bank Right
controls.description: Step one bank forward on each press. Keep the same scene position within the new bank.
context: The eight banks wrap around. From Outer Rim, one press left reaches Lantern Run. Fade Time sets the transition.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: SOLO · hold and release
controls.description: Hold a fresh press in Destroyer Passage for totality, then release for the return of sunlight. Other material scenes build pressure and respond on release.
context: In Lantern Run, hold to brighten the courier’s own lantern. Mute 1 launches the jump. After changing scenes, release and press again to acquire a material or eclipse gesture.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: Practical glow
controls.description: Set the optical bloom around bright scene lights.
context: Look around a bright lamp or engine. The Lantern Run bank bypasses this finish.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Chromatic aberration
controls.description: Separate red and blue slightly toward the edges while keeping the centre registered.
context: Look at a bright off-centre edge. Lantern Run bypasses this finish.
Filmed in Dune Freight.

controls.title: Focus plane
controls.description: Move the sharp plane from distant scenery to the foreground.
context: Outer Rim has depth-rendered focus, including Bathyal Engine. Open Aperture to see the rack. Factory shortcut is strip 6’s top knob with Zone Mix down.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: Aperture
controls.description: Open the lens to increase blur away from the focus plane. Zero gives the sharpest depth pass.
context: Outer Rim has depth-rendered blur. Other non-pixel banks use it for subtle edge softness. Factory shortcut is strip 6’s middle knob with Zone Mix down.
Filmed in Dune Freight.

controls.title: Laser level
controls.description: Set the base intensity of the scene’s beams. Blast and Flare can add a short accent.
context: Used by Destroyer Passage, Echo Sounding and Dune Freight. Factory shortcut is strip 6’s bottom knob with Zone Mix down.
Filmed in Echo Sounding.

controls.title: SOLO material strength
controls.description: Set how much material pressure a sustained SOLO press can build and release.
context: Try a long hold on Solar Sail, then release to see the membrane respond. Destroyer totality and the courier’s lantern use separate gestures.
Filmed in Gravity Loom.

controls.title: Night Orchard study mix
controls.description: At 0–1, fade directly into the chapter’s Drosera, Relief, Fold or Aurelia study.
context: Set the Magic Global back to −1 to let Structure and Opposite place the study. The override applies to the four Night Orchard chapters.
Filmed in Disco Jungle.

controls.title: Bathyal encounter mix
controls.description: At 0–1, fade Destroyer Passage into Bathyal Engine. At full level the cuttlefish fills the scene.
context: Set the Magic Global back to −1 to follow Structure. While the animal is fully selected, SOLO plays its material response.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: Destroyer eclipse phase
controls.description: Move the moon through approach at 0, totality at 0.5 and full sunlight at 1.
context: Set the Magic Global back to −1 for the natural orbit. A fresh SOLO press can hold totality and then play egress independently of travel speed.
Filmed in Destroyer Passage.

controls.title: World seed
controls.description: Choose a different arrangement of Outer Rim scenery while retaining the current scene’s subject.
context: The seed is repeatable at the same world time. Dune Freight retains its crawler and route while the landscape details change.
Filmed in Dune Freight.

controls.title: Archive / science mix
controls.description: In the five space banks, blend from the original scene through a mixed treatment to the full archive source. In Outer Rim, reveal the science view.
context: Follows InkLift on the factory project. Assign this Global separately to control the mix independently of Night Orchard’s black level.
Filmed in Reef Engine.
